# A11oy — Live Enterprise Execution Fabric

## One-Sentence Description
A11oy is a governed, reasoning agentic layer that senses business signals, explains their causes, recommends approved actions, executes them in Workcells, and records cryptographic proof of every step.

## Core Concepts

**Signal**: A structured business event from one of seven verticals (Lyte Revenue, Vessels Maritime, Terra Real Estate, Aegis Defense, PRISM Counsel, Carlota Jo, Alloy Core). Signals have severity (critical/high/medium/low/info), status, business impact, evidence refs, and structured metadata.

**Fabric Layer**: Seven in-memory layers process signals end-to-end: Coverage Graph → Signal Mesh → State Engine → Causal Core → Action Rail → Covenant Layer → Proof Ledger.

**Action Brief**: A recommended action produced by the Action Rail. Every ActionBrief has a priority, approval tier (auto/operator/executive/board), and estimated business impact. In Phase 1, mutating actions return 501.

**Covenant Policy**: A named rule evaluated by the Covenant Layer before any action executes. Policies can block, warn, log, or require_approval.

**Proof Packet**: A cryptographic record of a single step (signal ingestion, state transition, policy evaluation, human approval, action execution). Packets chain via `previousHash`.

**Proof-Carrying Execution Contract**: The end-to-end proof that chains: origin signal → causal analysis → policy evaluation → approval record → execution trace → proof packet.

**Workcell**: A governed, encapsulated agentic task. Workcells declare their tools, approval tier, and proof obligations. Phase 2 will activate the Workcell engine.

**Business Twin**: A living, structured model of each vertical entity, continuously updated from signals.

## API Reference

Base: `/api/a11oy/`

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/now` | GET | Current summary (signal counts, severity breakdown, fabric status) |
| `/signals` | GET | List signals (query: vertical, severity, status, limit, offset) |
| `/signals/:id` | GET | Get signal by ID |
| `/outcomes` | GET | List active outcomes |
| `/actions` | GET | List recommended/active actions |
| `/proof` | GET | List proof packets |
| `/proof/:entityId` | GET | Proof packets for an entity |
| `/governance` | GET | Active covenant policies |
| `/verticals` | GET | Registered verticals |
| `/fabric` | GET | Fabric layer health status |
| `/workcells` | GET | List workcells |
| `/workcells/:id` | GET | Get workcell by ID |

All responses use envelope: `{ ok: true, data: ..., meta: { timestamp, mode, phase } }`
Errors: `{ ok: false, error: { type, message, retryable, suggestion } }`

## Verticals
- `lyte-revenue` — SaaS revenue operations
- `vessels-maritime` — Maritime fleet and voyage management
- `terra-real-estate` — Real estate portfolio management
- `aegis-defense` — Defense and intelligence operations
- `prism-counsel` — Legal matter and contract management
- `carlota-jo` — Professional services consulting
- `alloy-core` — Platform fabric health

## Phase 1 Seed Data
- 32 business signals across 7 verticals
- 5 active outcomes
- 5 covenant policies (2 global, 3 vertical-specific)
- 5 proof packets

## Key Files
- `artifacts/a11oy/src/a11oy/core/` — types.ts, constants.ts, terminology.ts, demoMode.ts
- `artifacts/a11oy/src/a11oy/schema/index.ts` — All TypeScript interfaces + Zod validators
- `artifacts/a11oy/src/a11oy/fabric/` — Seven in-memory fabric layer implementations
- `artifacts/a11oy/src/a11oy/demo/` — Seed data files
- `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/a11oy-fabric-api.ts` — REST API route handlers

## Demo Mode
Phase 1 is in Demo Mode: all data in-memory, no external calls, mutating endpoints return 501.
